items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Allie Ross told me once ... because he wanted to know why he always hired me.

ctx.x: No, he wasn't that advanced. He wasn't that advanced. And sometimes, a fellow -- somebody come up with a manuscript and hand it around and (unintelligible). And (unintelligible) or whoever it was just wanted to get an idea of what the men could do, see. He knows what it's supposed to sound like, but he wants to see which one could read good and which one couldn't.

So, all right, fellows, let's go now, start from the top, left, right, lefthand corner, all right. And if you can read what's on there, you'd go straight ahead and read it until he tells you to stop. But when he tells you to stop, he's got a pretty good idea who's reading their part and who isn't.
